question: In which of the following regions, a cyclone is known as "Typhoon"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** typhoon **is a type of **tropical cyclone** that occurs in the **northwestern Pacific Ocean**, specifically in the region around **Japan.**
 
• Typhoons are known for their **strong winds, heavy rain**, and potential for **destructive storm surges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In** India**, **cyclones **are typically referred to as "cyclonic storms" or "severe cyclonic storms."
 
• **Canada and Brazil **are not typically associated with tropical cyclones, but they may experience other types of storms such as** hurricanes or typhoons** in other regions of the world.
 
• It is important to note that typhoons, hurricanes, and cyclones are all essentially the same type of storm, but are given** different names **depending on the region in which they occur.
